title: Project Hygiene: .gitignore & README.md
introduction: Professional repositories are clean and well-documented. Today you master `.gitignore` to prevent clutter, build artifacts, and sensitive API secrets from ever entering Git history, and learn how to write an engaging `README.md` using GitHub-Flavored Markdown.
why_it_matters: Committing passwords or `.env` files is a major security vulnerability that Git permanently records unless cleaned. Furthermore, a clear README is the first impression recruiters, mentors, and open-source contributors get of your project.
practical_activity_preview: Add a `.gitignore` ignoring logs and environment variables, and format a professional `README.md`.
